hook: Your chips packet is full of gas, on purpose.
title: Your chips packet is full of gas on purpose
description:
Grab any puffed packet of chips and you are holding a bag filled with nitrogen. The gas pushes out oxygen, which makes oils go stale, and it cushions the chips so fewer break. Try squeezing one and see.

#Shorts #FoodFacts #TechFacts

scenes.narration: Your chips packet is full of gas, on purpose.
scenes.headline: Full Of Gas, On Purpose

scenes.narration: It's nitrogen, pushed in before sealing.
scenes.headline: Filled With Nitrogen

scenes.narration: Oxygen makes the oil in chips go stale.
scenes.headline: Oxygen Spoils Chips

scenes.narration: So the chips stay fresh much longer.
scenes.headline: Stays Fresh Longer

scenes.narration: The puffed bag also cushions every chip.
scenes.headline: A Gas Cushion

scenes.narration: Without it, you'd get more crumbs.
scenes.headline: No Gas, More Crumbs

scenes.narration: So yes, your packet is full of gas.
scenes.headline: Gas Is Protection

scenes.narration: Next: a country you can walk across.
scenes.headline: Next: Tiny Country
